title: SarnautCore character creation option
description: One selectable character-creation option, per ADR 0032. Neither the client nor the server may hold a starting item, stat, ability or spawn coordinate in code, so every one of them is a field here. Options are global: a chargen document names the zone it spawns into but is not scoped to one. Options that are not playable yet ship with enabled:false rather than being absent, so enabling the next one is a data change CI has already been validating.

race.description: Canonical race id. M2 has no race document type, so this is a taxonomy token rather than a reference the cross-reference pass resolves.

class.description: Canonical class id. As with race, M2 has no class document type.

sex.description: The body variant this option renders with. It is a property of the option, not a customization axis: ADR 0032 section 4 gives M2 no appearance data model, and every character of an option renders identically.

faction.description: Canonical faction id, resolved against a faction document.

enabled.description: Whether the client may offer this option. This is how "one playable option in M2" is expressed.

visual_ref.description: The model and material every character of this option renders with.

slot.description: An equipment slot, or bag for anything not equipped at first spawn.
